verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents some processing that runs in the background without user action. It applies AI summaries and automatic labels to incoming mail, filters junk, and claims API integrations that keep documents and mail in sync with other tools. However, nothing shows users can define their own automations, such as rule-based triggers or scheduled actions, that then run on their own. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable automation or rules builder, trigger/action workflows, evidence that integration sync is user-set-up and runs unattended, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
